name: quickbooks-desktop-conductor
label: QuickBooks Desktop (via Conductor)
description: Sync invoices, bills, customers, vendors and payments with QuickBooks Desktop through the Conductor API bridge.

secretKey.label: Conductor Secret Key
secretKey.description: From your Conductor dashboard, Settings → API Keys.

endUserId.label: Conductor End-User ID
endUserId.description: The end-user ID for this QuickBooks Desktop company file (starts with end_usr_).

upsert_customer.label: Upsert Customer
upsert_customer.description: Creates a customer in QuickBooks Desktop, or updates it if one with the same name already exists.

name.label: Customer Name
name.description: The exact name of the customer as it should appear in QuickBooks Desktop (max 41 characters). Used to find an existing customer — if one already exists with this exact name, it is updated instead of duplicated.

upsert_vendor.label: Upsert Vendor
upsert_vendor.description: Creates a vendor in QuickBooks Desktop, or updates it if one with the same name already exists.

name.label: Vendor Name
name.description: The exact name of the vendor as it should appear in QuickBooks Desktop (max 41 characters, unique across all vendors). Used to find an existing vendor — if one already exists with this exact name, it is updated instead of duplicated.
